Summary: enterprise logistics SaaS evaluating Redwood Dedicated for customer-facing chat+search features. Very throughput-sensitive for peak booking windows; must guarantee latency SLOs for SLA with customers.

Key quotes: 'If we can't hit p95 < 300ms at peak, we lose enterprise accounts' — Head of Product.

Baseline workload: daily steady-state QPS approx 12 QPS across US region for customer chat (avg request ~350 tokens). Baseline batch rerank jobs run overnight and during surge windows.

Sizing workshop outcomes (10/28 onsite):
- Measured baseline request profile from prod logs (Aug-Sep): median tokens/request = 340, 95th = 820.
- Baseline steady-state QPS target for Dedicated: 45 QPS (chat + API mix) = ~15k tokens/sec sustained.
- Peak window: 3x steady-state for booking surges => target peak tokens/sec = 45k (30s windows).
- Desired tail SLOs: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 300ms, p99 < 600ms for 1k token requests; reranking jobs can be relaxed to p95 < 2s.
